messages:
alex: Heads-up — docs/site cutoff for v1.8 is in ~12h. Need SDK docs regen, changelog entry, and console docs deploy gated to the release branch. Please confirm owners and call out blockers.

maya: I can take SDK regen. Quick Q: which branch should I target? release/v1.8 or main?

alex: target release/v1.8. We want the docs pinned to the release commit. Minimal checklist:
- bump docs/version.txt to `v1.8.0`
- run `yarn docs:build && yarn docs:export`
- commit artifacts to `docs-site` repo open PR -> release/v1.8
- add a short 'What's new' snippet for the docs index

sam: I'll handle the site deploy once the PR merges and CI artifacts look good. My deploy command is: 
```
./scripts/deploy-docs.sh --source artifacts/docs/v1.8 --target s3://docs.redwood.ai/v1.8
```
If we need a rollback plan: I keep the previous artifact in `s3://docs.redwood.ai/v1.7` and can copy it back.

luis: Also remember SDK-side steps: regen script is `python -m sdk.docs.generate --out sdk/python/docs`. Commit the generated docs under `sdk/python/docs/` in the SDK repo and bump `pyproject.toml` to `0.3.2` (or whatever the release tag ends up being).

maya: Got it. Also: where should the changelog entry live? Release notes repo or inside the docs?

anya: Changelog goes in `infra/release-notes/release-notes/v1.8.md`. We should also add a short blurb to the docs index under 'Release notes' — I'll add that after the release-notes PR merges.

devops-bot: CI: docs-build passed for PR #324 (docs-site). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/324 (expires in 7d).

sam: Noted — staging deploy started but failing on image resize step with `Error: cannot allocate memory`. Debugging now, pinging infra. @infra-oncall

luis: If staging is blocked we can still merge docs PRs but hold the `docs-deploy` job. Important: tag the release branch before final deploy: `git tag -a v1.8.0 -m "v1.8.0 release" && git push origin v1.8.0` — tagging ensures the docs route matches the release tag.

alex: Owners: SDK regen = maya, changelog/release notes = anya, deploy = sam. I'll do the final version bump in `docs/version.txt` and cut the prune 2h before cutoff. Please ping here when PRs are green. :thumbsup:

maya: Starting SDK regen now, will push the PR to `release/v1.8` in ~30m.

sam: I'll keep an eye on the staging job and post updates here. If I can't fix the resize quickly, I'll switch the job to use the legacy image pipeline and re-run.

anya: Adding a placeholder changelog entry now so we don't forget. I'll update it with final copy once features are locked.

alex: Thanks everyone — if you hit CI flakes, mention this thread. We'll avoid last-minute edits to main after cutoff.
